diagnostic_questions.question: In which Canadian province does the couple reside or did they reside during the relationship?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Which provincial property-division framework applies; BC and Ontario have materially different rules for unmarried couples and province is a threshold diagnostic fact
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If BC: proceed to assess 2-year cohabitation threshold and written opt-out agreement
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If not BC: apply the relevant provincial framework; do not apply BC Family Law Act rules

diagnostic_questions.question: Is there any evidence of risk to the child's physical, emotional, or psychological safety, security, or well-being in the proposed parenting arrangement?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the primary statutory consideration under Divorce Act s.16(2) is engaged — if yes, this factor must be weighed first before all others
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Court must give this finding primary consideration; it is not available to be simply balanced against competing factors such as stability or continuity
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Court proceeds to weigh the remaining enumerated and non-enumerated factors on a case-by-case basis without a mandatory priority ordering among them

diagnostic_questions.question: Has at least one spouse resided in a Canadian province or territory for at least one year?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the threshold residency requirement under the Divorce Act is satisfied — without this, the Act does not apply
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Proceed to assess which ground for divorce applies and whether the separation period has been met
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Divorce under the federal Divorce Act is unavailable; explore whether limited alternatives under the Civil Marriage Act apply

diagnostic_questions.question: Were the parties legally married, or were they in a common-law relationship?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Determines whether Ontario's equalization framework applies at all — it applies only to married spouses
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If married: proceed to calculate net family property for each spouse and determine equalization payment
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If common-law: automatic property division does not apply in Ontario; ask whether a cohabitation agreement exists

diagnostic_questions.question: Is there any history of family violence involving either parent?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Tests the family violence factor explicitly enumerated under California Family Code §3011 — presence of this factor materially affects the custody determination
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Assess whether violence is documented; documentation strengthens the factor's evidentiary weight; also triggers connection to abuse-screening considerations that may override other relationship-repair calculus
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: This §3011 factor is neutral; custody analysis proceeds on the remaining five factors

diagnostic_questions.question: Has at least one spouse lived in California continuously for the last 6 months?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the state-level residency requirement for California divorce filing is satisfied
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Proceed to assess the 3-month county residency requirement
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Filing in California is not currently permitted; calculate when the 6-month threshold will be reached

diagnostic_questions.question: In which US state are you and your spouse domiciled?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Determines which property division regime — community property or equitable distribution — governs the divorce.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If the state is Arizona, California, Idaho, Louisiana, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, Washington, or Wisconsin: community property applies — marital assets and debts are split 50/50 by operation of law.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If the state is none of the above (and not Alaska): equitable distribution applies — the court will apply state-specific fairness factors to determine the split.

diagnostic_questions.question: Have the partners lived together in a marriage-like relationship for at least 2 years?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the 2-year threshold under BC's Family Law Act is met, which is the gateway condition for any statutory property-division right to exist
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Statutory property-division rights under BC's Family Law Act apply unless a written opt-out agreement exists
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: No statutory property-division right exists by default under BC's Family Law Act; assess whether any written agreement creates alternative rights

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the proposed parenting arrangement support continuity of the child's cultural, linguistic, religious, spiritual, or Indigenous heritage?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the explicitly enumerated heritage and upbringing factor under the Divorce Act is satisfied
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: This factor supports the arrangement; court weighs it alongside other non-safety factors
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Absence of heritage continuity is a factor weighing against the arrangement, to be balanced case-by-case against other non-safety factors

diagnostic_questions.question: Have the spouses been separated and living apart for at least 12 months?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the separation-based ground — the predominant no-fault path — is available for finalization
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: The separation ground is available; the divorce application can be finalized
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: The divorce cannot yet be finalized on separation grounds; determine exact separation date to calculate when finalization becomes possible, or assess whether a fault-based ground with evidentiary proof is being pursued

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the couple located in Ontario (as opposed to another Canadian province such as BC)?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Province is determinative — Ontario's complete absence of automatic common-law property division is directly contrary to BC's rule; province must be established before any property guidance is given
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Apply Ontario rules: no automatic division for common-law; equalization for married
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Apply the province-specific rules of the relevant province — do not assume Ontario rules apply

diagnostic_questions.question: Does either parent have a pattern of regular and ongoing substance abuse?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Tests the substance abuse factor under California Family Code §3011 — the statutory threshold is 'regular and ongoing,' not isolated or historical use
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Assess whether the pattern is current and documentable; this factor weighs against the affected parent in custody proceedings
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: This §3011 factor is neutral; isolated or past substance use does not meet the statutory threshold of 'regular and ongoing'

diagnostic_questions.question: Has at least one spouse resided in their current California county for the last 3 months?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the county-level venue requirement for California divorce filing is satisfied
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Both residency requirements are met; the spouse may file in that county
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Filing in that specific county is not yet permitted; calculate when the 3-month county threshold will be reached

diagnostic_questions.question: If domiciled in Alaska, did you and your spouse execute a community property agreement?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Determines whether Alaska's opt-in community property treatment applies or whether the default equitable distribution regime governs.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Community property rules apply — marital assets and debts are split 50/50.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Equitable distribution applies — the 50/50 split is not guaranteed and fairness factors will govern.

diagnostic_questions.question: Did the couple execute a written agreement contracting out of BC's Family Law Act default property-division rules?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the statutory defaults have been displaced by private agreement, which entirely removes the Family Law Act's automatic property-division framework
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: The written agreement governs property division; the Family Law Act defaults do not apply
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: The Family Law Act's default property-division rules apply automatically if the 2-year threshold is met

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the child expressed views about the parenting arrangement, and what is the child's age and maturity level?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether and how much weight the child's expressed preferences carry under the Divorce Act's best interests factors
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Views are considered and weighted proportionally to age and maturity — they are a factor but explicitly not determinative
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Absence of expressed views or insufficient maturity means this factor does not contribute to the determination

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the divorce being sought on the ground of cruelty or adultery rather than separation?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the filing spouse is prepared to meet an evidentiary burden of proof, as both fault-based grounds require proof
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Assess whether sufficient evidence exists to establish cruelty or adultery to the court's standard; note that these grounds are rarely pursued given the availability of the no-fault separation route
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Confirm the separation date and proceed under the one-year separation ground

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the property at issue include the matrimonial home?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Tests whether the standard exclusions for pre-marriage value, gifts, or inheritances can be applied — they cannot be applied to the matrimonial home
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Include the full current value of the matrimonial home in the equalization calculation without any pre-marriage, gift, or inheritance deduction
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Standard exclusions (pre-marriage value, gifts, inheritances) may apply to the non-home property in question

diagnostic_questions.question: How established is the child in their current school, home, and community?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Tests the community and school ties factor under California Family Code §3011 — stability and continuity of the child's environment is a named statutory consideration
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Strong existing ties weigh in favor of the parent who can maintain continuity of those ties post-separation
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If ties are weak or the child is young and not yet established, this factor carries less determinative weight relative to the other §3011 factors

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the person recently relocated to a new state or a new county within California?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether a residency waiting period is an active constraint on filing timeline
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Surface the residency window requirements as a concrete eligibility gate before discussing filing mechanics
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Residency is likely established; verify exact move-in dates to confirm both thresholds are met

diagnostic_questions.question: Was the asset in question acquired during the marriage, or was it owned before the marriage or received as a gift or inheritance?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Determines whether the asset is marital (subject to division) or separate property (excluded from division) under community property rules.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If acquired during the marriage: the asset is community property subject to 50/50 division in a community property state.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If owned before the marriage or received as a gift or inheritance: the asset is separate property and is generally excluded from division.

diagnostic_questions.question: Was the asset in question acquired before or during the relationship?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the asset falls within the 'family property' pool subject to division or is excluded as pre-relationship property
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If acquired during the relationship: asset is generally subject to division under BC's Family Law Act
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If brought into the relationship: asset is excluded from division and remains the separate property of the partner who owned it pre-relationship

diagnostic_questions.question: Are there case-specific circumstances relevant to the child's best interests that are not captured by the enumerated statutory factors?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the non-exhaustive nature of the Divorce Act factor list should be invoked to consider additional circumstances
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Court may and should consider those additional factors under the non-exhaustive list authority
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Determination proceeds on the enumerated factors alone

diagnostic_questions.question: Are there dependent children whose living arrangements and decision-making must be addressed?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether parenting arrangements — the statutory term under the Divorce Act as of March 1, 2021 — must be established as part of the divorce proceeding
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Parenting arrangements must be addressed; use the terminology and framework in force since March 1, 2021, not the former 'custody and access' language
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Child-related arrangements are not required; proceed with the divorce on the applicable ground

diagnostic_questions.question: How long ago did the spouses separate, and has the divorce been finalized — and if so, when?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Tests whether the limitation period for an equalization court claim has expired — the deadline is the earlier of 6 years from separation or 2 years from finalized divorce
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If within the limitation period: equalization claim may still be brought; calculate the applicable deadline precisely
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If limitation period has passed: court claim for equalization is barred

diagnostic_questions.question: What is the nature and strength of the emotional bond between each parent and the child?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Tests the emotional ties factor under California Family Code §3011 — courts assess the quality of the existing relationship between each parent and the child
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Strong emotional bond with one parent relative to the other weighs in favor of that parent in custody proceedings
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If emotional ties are comparable between parents, this factor does not differentiate and the remaining §3011 factors carry greater relative weight

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the person asking whether to leave the relationship, or how to file for divorce given their current location?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the relevant information needed is emotional/repairability diagnosis or legal/procedural filing mechanics — these are distinct questions requiring different information
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If asking 'how to file': assess residency eligibility first before discussing process
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If asking 'whether to leave': address repairability diagnosis without conflating legal filing mechanics

diagnostic_questions.question: In an equitable distribution state, what were the respective financial and non-financial contributions of each spouse during the marriage?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Tests the fairness factors — income disparity, homemaking, and career support — that courts use to determine the property split in equitable distribution states.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If significant non-financial contributions or income disparity exist: these are recognized factors that can shift the division away from 50/50.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If contributions were roughly equal and incomes similar: the outcome may approach 50/50 but remains subject to judicial discretion.

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the divorce application been filed before the 12-month separation period is complete?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the applicant understands that early filing is permitted but does not accelerate the finalization date
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Confirm that the applicant understands finalization cannot occur until the full 12 months have elapsed from the date of separation
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: No issue — filing after 12 months means finalization can proceed without a waiting period post-filing

diagnostic_questions.question: For common-law couples: did the partners sign a cohabitation agreement, and does it address property division?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Determines whether any enforceable property-division terms exist for a common-law couple in Ontario, where no automatic rights exist
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Apply the terms of the cohabitation agreement to determine each partner's property entitlements
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Each partner retains only what is individually in their name — no further property-division entitlement exists under Ontario law

diagnostic_questions.question: Does each parent have the practical ability to care for the child on a day-to-day basis?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Tests the caregiving capacity factor under California Family Code §3011 — courts compare each parent's functional ability to meet the child's needs
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If both parents have comparable caregiving capacity, this factor does not differentiate and other §3011 factors carry greater weight
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: A significant disparity in caregiving capacity between parents weighs in favor of the more capable parent in the custody determination

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the filing spouse believe they need the other spouse's consent or must prove fault to obtain a divorce in California?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the person understands California's no-fault model, which requires neither spousal agreement nor proof of wrongdoing
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Clarify that California's no-fault model explicitly states: 'You don't need your spouse's agreement to get a divorce. You can get divorced for any reason.'
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Person already understands no-fault basis; focus on procedural residency requirements

diagnostic_questions.question: How long was the marriage?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: In equitable distribution states, marriage length is an explicit fairness factor that courts weigh in determining property division.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: A longer marriage may support a larger share for a lower-earning or non-earning spouse as a recognized fairness factor.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: A shorter marriage may reduce the weight courts give to non-financial contributions or income disparity in the property split.

diagnostic_questions.question: Does your sense of whether this relationship is working change significantly based on how your last conversation with your partner went?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the person's relationship evaluation is driven by momentary attachment-state reactivity rather than stable pattern recognition
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Can you describe how you assessed the relationship one week ago versus today — and what happened in between? This maps the reactivity window and identifies the triggering interaction
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Describe the last three times your sense of the relationship shifted — this tests whether the 'no' is accurate or whether the pattern is present but unrecognized

diagnostic_questions.question: Has your partner ever told you that you never do anything right, used demeaning language toward you, or publicly humiliated you?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Screens for warning signs 1 and 4 (criticism and emotional abuse); these are often the earliest and most normalized indicators
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Stop standard framework; surface the one-or-two threshold explicitly and provide hotline referral with all three contact options
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Continue screening for remaining 10 warning signs before proceeding to standard repairability framework

diagnostic_questions.question: When you try to repair after a fight — apologize, de-escalate, reconnect — does it usually work, or does it usually fail the same way?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the relationship has a functioning repair mechanism; this is the core predictor variable Gottman identifies as distinguishing repairable relationships from those heading toward dissolution
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What does a successful repair look like — who initiates, what do they do, how long does it take?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: How does it fail — does one partner reject the attempt, does it escalate, or does the repair seem to work but the same issue resurfaces unchanged?

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the involved partner stopped all contact with the affair partner, and what specific steps have been taken to prevent accidental contact?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the threshold condition for repair is present; the specificity of the answer distinguishes genuine structural change from vague intention
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Have there been any accidental encounters since? If so, did your partner tell you before you asked?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: What is the stated reason contact has not stopped, and does the betrayed partner accept that reason as legitimate?

diagnostic_questions.question: When your partner is being warm or affectionate toward you, what happens to your own warmth or desire to connect?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the person is exhibiting deactivating strategies — avoidant attachment characteristically produces diminished warmth in response to perceived partner warmth, which is a key diagnostic signal
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Does the pull to create distance feel like preference or like discomfort with the closeness itself? This distinguishes preference-based unavailability from a triggered protective response
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Does your partner report that you become more distant when they are most open? Sometimes the pattern is not self-visible but is visible to the other person

diagnostic_questions.question: Has your partner tried to limit your contact with friends or family, or made you feel you needed permission to see people?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Screens for warning sign 3 (isolation); isolation is a key mechanism that reduces access to support and increases dependency
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Stop standard framework; note that isolation may already be limiting the person's ability to safely access resources — address safe contact mode before referral
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Continue screening for remaining warning signs

diagnostic_questions.question: Is there mockery, eye-rolling, sarcasm meant to demean, or a sense that one partner views the other with contempt?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the highest single predictor of divorce is present; this distinguishes a conflict-heavy but repairable relationship from one where the emotional foundation has been fundamentally eroded
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How long has contempt been present, and does the other partner recognize and name it as contempt or reframe it as humor or frustration?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Which of the remaining three Horsemen are present, and is there evidence of active repair culture to offset them?

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the involved partner ever voluntarily disclosed something about their whereabouts or the affair partner without being asked?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether transparency is proactive or reactive; proactive disclosure in low-stakes moments is a stronger signal of internalized commitment than disclosure under direct questioning
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What did they disclose, and did it come before or after you had any reason to ask?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Is all transparency in this relationship currently initiated by the betrayed partner's questions rather than the involved partner's offerings?

diagnostic_questions.question: When you felt most certain that you needed to leave (or stay), what had just happened in the relationship immediately before that certainty arrived?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the felt certainty was preceded by an interpersonal trigger that would activate an insecure attachment state, which would indicate the certainty is attachment-state noise rather than independent evaluation
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How does your assessment of the relationship compare when you are in a calm, neutral state with no recent conflict? Divergence between the two states is diagnostic of attachment-driven distortion
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If there was no specific trigger, assess whether the certainty has remained stable across multiple emotional states over time — stability across states is more reliable than intensity at a single moment

diagnostic_questions.question: Has your partner controlled money in the household without consulting you, or withheld funds you needed?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Screens for warning sign 6 (financial control); financial control affects both current safety planning and the person's perceived ability to leave
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Stop standard framework; financial control intersects with safety planning — hotline's Plan for Safety tools are specifically relevant here
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Continue screening for remaining warning signs

diagnostic_questions.question: In a typical week, do positive interactions — appreciation, affection, humor, genuine curiosity about each other — outnumber negative ones by roughly five to one?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: The current state of the emotional bank account; a depleted ratio means the relationship lacks the buffer to absorb conflict and repair is harder to initiate and receive
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Are the positive interactions spontaneous and mutual, or concentrated in one partner or in scripted/obligatory moments?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: When did the ratio shift, and was there an identifiable event or a gradual drift?

diagnostic_questions.question: When the two of you have a planned difficult conversation about the infidelity, how does the involved partner typically show up — defensive or non-defensive?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the involved partner is prioritizing self-protection or relationship repair in the moments that most directly test their commitment to the process
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Does non-defensiveness persist throughout the conversation or appear early and then shift when the questions get specific?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: What form does the defensiveness take — denial, minimization, counter-attack, or shutdown?

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the way you see this relationship's problems shifted substantially when you were in a good period together versus a difficult period?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the person's relationship assessment is state-dependent — large divergence across emotional states indicates that one or both assessments are contaminated by attachment reactivity
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Which assessment do you trust more, and why? This reveals whether the person has a theory about which state gives clearer perception, or whether they are defaulting to the most recent or most intense one
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Consistency across states can indicate either genuine stable assessment or a pattern of minimizing/dismissing (deactivating) — follow up on whether the 'no change' reflects genuine evaluation or suppression of negative signals

diagnostic_questions.question: Have you ever felt afraid of your partner because of a look, a gesture, damage to property, or a threat — even if they never physically harmed you?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Screens for warning signs 9, 11, and 12 (intimidation, weapon intimidation, property destruction); surfaces the non-physical abuse behaviors that are most frequently minimized
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Stop standard framework; validate that non-physical fear-inducing behavior meets the threshold and provide full hotline referral
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Continue screening; also screens implicitly for whether the person's threshold for 'abuse' is anchored only to physical harm

diagnostic_questions.question: When one partner raises a complaint, does it typically come out as a description of a specific behavior and a stated need, or as a verdict on the other person's character?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether criticism has escalated into character-level attack, which is harder to respond to non-defensively and more likely to invite contempt over time
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Does the partner receiving the complaint typically respond with acknowledgment or with counter-complaint?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Does the person raising complaints recognize this pattern, or do they believe they are communicating specific needs?

diagnostic_questions.question: Are both partners actively doing something to participate in the repair process, or is the work sitting almost entirely with one person?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the process matches the research model of bilateral effort; unilateral repair processes are structurally different from what the evidence describes and may be less likely to produce durable trust
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What specifically is the betrayed partner doing, and is it experienced as active engagement or exhausting obligation?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Which partner is carrying the full burden, and what is the stated reason the other partner is not engaged?

diagnostic_questions.question: Do you believe your situation 'counts' as abuse, or does it feel like it's not serious enough to reach out for help?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Reveals whether minimization or comparative severity thinking is blocking access to resources even when warning signs have already been identified
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Confirm the one-or-two threshold from the source explicitly; proceed to referral
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Explore what the person believes the threshold for 'real' abuse is; address the gap between their threshold and the source's explicit standard

diagnostic_questions.question: When one partner shuts down or goes silent during conflict, does the other interpret this as rejection, or do both partners have a shared understanding of what is happening and what to do?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether stonewalling is understood as a physiological flooding response (which has a structural antidote) or is experienced as abandonment (which triggers escalation and makes repair harder)
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Do they have an agreed timeout protocol, and does it get used consistently?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: How does the non-stonewalling partner respond — pursue, escalate, or also withdraw?

diagnostic_questions.question: When a painful setback or regression occurs, how do both partners interpret it — as evidence the process has failed or as expected non-linearity?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the couple has a shared framework for the process that can absorb difficulty; couples without this framework are vulnerable to premature exit or recursive re-traumatization
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Has this framework been explicitly named between the partners or is it just a shared implicit tolerance?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Does every setback trigger a full re-evaluation of whether the relationship is over?

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the recurring pattern shown any visible movement — in either direction — over the last several months, or has it remained static?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the relationship is stuck at an outcome level; distinguishes a rough patch (trajectory exists) from a repeating pattern (no trajectory)
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What does that movement look like — is it holding across different emotional states and conflict episodes, or only in low-stakes moments?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Is the no-progress appearing across all conditions, or does it reset specifically when closeness increases or conflict peaks — which would suggest an attachment mechanism, not a relationship ceiling?

diagnostic_questions.question: Did the urge to end the relationship follow a specific moment of increased closeness, vulnerability, or emotional exposure — or did it build gradually and independently of such moments?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the exit desire is consistent with avoidant deactivation triggered by intimacy, or whether it reflects accumulating genuine dissatisfaction that exists independently of attachment-system activation
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Can you identify what specifically happened in that moment of closeness — was there a request for dependency, a declaration of feeling, a step toward greater commitment? This maps the deactivation trigger precisely.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: What has been building, and over what timeframe? This shifts the analysis toward genuine incompatibility or pattern-based deterioration rather than deactivation.

diagnostic_questions.question: Do I still feel safe with this person, even when I am angry?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the foundational condition for repair — emotional safety — is present; a no answer points toward breakage rather than depletion
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Proceed to assess whether pain is sourced in what is missing versus what has been done
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Probe whether the unsafety involves any form of active abuse before proceeding; if yes, the repair framework does not apply

diagnostic_questions.question: When you say your partner is unwilling to work on this, what does that unwillingness look like in practice?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the unwillingness is a stable trait or a state-dependent response — engagement that disappears under emotional load suggests deactivation rather than genuine refusal
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Does the unwillingness appear across all emotional states, or specifically when the conversation gets close to the core attachment dynamic?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If they show some willingness, what conditions bring it out — and are those conditions replicable?

diagnostic_questions.question: Are the reasons you want to leave longstanding, substantive concerns about values or behavior — or are they petty, minor, or newly salient issues about habits, appearance, or inconsequential actions?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the complaints driving the exit decision are real incompatibility signals or manufactured exit reasons generated by the avoidant attachment system as a proximity-regulation mechanism
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: When did these issues first bother you? Have they been present throughout the relationship or did they become noticeable recently — and if recently, what else changed at the same time?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If the issues are substantive and longstanding, what has prevented this from being resolved or acted on earlier? This opens the question of whether the relationship is broken versus depleted.

diagnostic_questions.question: When I imagine my partner at their best, do I still want that person?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the loss of desire is situational — tied to the current depleted state of the partner — or fundamental, meaning the person no longer wants the relationship even under ideal conditions
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: This supports the depleted framing; explore what external or internal conditions have suppressed access to that version of the partner
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: This points toward fundamental incompatibility or irreversible erosion; explore whether contempt, values conflict, or prolonged breakage explains the loss

diagnostic_questions.question: Are you able to separate whether this relationship was valuable from whether it is currently meeting your needs?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the person is operating under the past-value distortion that blocks functional leave decisions
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What does an honest needs assessment show — and what would need to change for needs to be met going forward?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: This is the distortion to address first before any stay-or-leave reasoning will be reliable; the framework question needs to be reset

diagnostic_questions.question: Do you recognize avoidant attachment patterns in yourself — such as feeling relationships take too much time, discomfort when a partner becomes dependent on you, or a history of finding reasons to exit when relationships deepen?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the person has the self-awareness to apply deactivation-as-false-clarity as a check on their own exit urge, or whether they are likely to take their felt certainty at face value
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Given that you recognize this pattern, how confident are you that this instance is different — what would distinguish genuine incompatibility from the pattern repeating?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Explore the history of how and when previous relationships ended — recurring patterns of exiting when things deepened may reveal avoidant deactivation even without self-identified attachment style.

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the pain from what is missing or from what has been done?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: The structural nature of the damage; missing-based pain indicates depletion, done-based pain indicates breakage through specific acts of betrayal, contempt, or harm
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If pain is from what has been done, identify the specific acts and assess whether they constitute abuse or contempt-level damage
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If pain is from what is missing, assess what specifically is absent and whether it was present before, supporting the depleted framing

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the ongoing anxiety you're experiencing consistent across the relationship, or does it spike specifically when distance increases or closeness is attempted?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the anxiety is a relationship-level signal or a hyperactivation signal that may be reading ordinary avoidant distance as threat
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If it spikes at closeness attempts, that pattern is consistent with anxious hyperactivation — the anxiety is a data point about the attachment dynamic, not necessarily about the relationship's viability
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Consistent baseline anxiety across all relational states is a stronger signal that the relationship dynamic itself, not just the attachment mechanism, is the driver

diagnostic_questions.question: Is your partner currently pushing harder for closeness or reassurance than usual — and did your withdrawal or dissatisfaction increase at the same time that pushing increased?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the anxious-avoidant reinforcement loop is active and generating distorted signals for both partners, making the current moment a particularly unreliable time to assess whether the relationship is repairable
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: The loop itself may be producing most of the distress — the diagnostic question becomes whether the relationship has a functional baseline outside of loop activation, not whether the current state is sustainable.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If the partner is not pushing and withdrawal is still occurring, this is more consistent with genuine incompatibility or independent dissatisfaction than with deactivation triggered by the push-pull dynamic.

diagnostic_questions.question: Are both partners willing to try, or is only one partner doing the repair work?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the structural condition for repair — bilateral willingness — is present; unilateral effort signals a blocked repair path regardless of the effort's quality
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If both are willing, assess whether both are actively pursuing help or only one
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If only one is willing, treat this as a 'let go' indicator rather than a problem to solve through increased effort

diagnostic_questions.question: Is there active abuse of any kind — physical, emotional, financial, or sexual?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the hard override condition is present; if yes, the depleted/broken diagnostic framework does not apply and the indicated path is safety planning and exit
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Exit the repair diagnostic entirely and redirect to safety resources
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Proceed with the depleted/broken framework beginning with the safety and best-self questions

diagnostic_questions.question: Has contempt replaced conflict in the relationship?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the negative relational pattern has crossed from repairable conflict to contempt, which specifically predicts failure; this distinction carries more predictive weight than conflict intensity or frequency
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Treat as a 'let go' indicator; contempt signals a qualitatively different level of damage from ordinary conflict
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Assess the nature and pattern of conflict; high-conflict relationships with mutual respect may still be in the depleted category

diagnostic_questions.question: Do the good years outweigh the bad in the overall arc of the relationship?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether there is an established history of positive relational functioning that supports the case for repair; a relationship that has been predominantly difficult has less evidence of restorable foundations
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: This supports the 'worth fighting for' framing; use as evidence that positive relational structure existed and may be recoverable
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Probe whether the current difficulty represents an anomaly or the dominant pattern, and whether the positive history the person is holding onto is accurate or idealized

diagnostic_questions.question: Has your partner communicated their needs to you clearly and directly — not just once, but repeatedly — and have you failed to act on those communications?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the problem is a communication gap (potentially fixable) or a prioritization/willingness gap (not fixable through more communication)
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Ask: have you made any concrete, sustained behavioral change in response? If no, the problem is not that they haven't told you — it's that you've chosen not to respond.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Ask: is it possible they have communicated and you haven't absorbed it? OP describes hearing words without absorbing them — this is a separate failure mode.

diagnostic_questions.question: Who initiated the breakup — you or them?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Determines whether you have any natural leverage in the dynamic; the dumper retains agency, the dumpee must work from a deficit
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If you are the dumper: are you reconsidering because of genuine renewed connection or fear of loneliness?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If you are the dumpee: is there any evidence they are open to reconnection, or are you projecting?

diagnostic_questions.question: Is your pain coming in waves with periods of relative stability, or is it a flat unrelenting baseline?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Wave patterns indicate active processing is occurring; flat unrelenting baselines suggest emotional avoidance or rumination loops that are blocking progression
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If waves: identify what triggers the waves and whether exposure is happening at an appropriate pace
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If flat constant pain: assess whether distraction or numbing behaviors are preventing any emotional engagement

diagnostic_questions.question: Are you missing this specific person, or are you missing the experience of being partnered?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Distinguishes between grief that requires processing the loss of a particular individual versus loneliness that is fundamentally about attachment needs — the interventions and timelines differ substantially
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If missing the specific person: can you identify concrete, irreplaceable qualities they had, or do the qualities generalize to 'a good partner'?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If missing partnership in general: what attachment needs went unmet before this relationship, and are those needs being addressed independently?

diagnostic_questions.question: Outside of this partner, how many people can you reach out to right now for emotional support?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the person has a functional support network or whether the relationship served as their entire social infrastructure — which determines the severity of the recovery challenge
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Are those people aware of what you're going through, and have you actually contacted them since the breakup?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Is the lack of a support network a product of the relationship (did you pull away from others while with this person) or a pre-existing pattern?

diagnostic_questions.question: Who was doing the majority of the relational labor — planning, cooking, initiating repair, tracking the relationship's health?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the relationship had structural effort asymmetry that made its failure predictable regardless of how 'fine' it appeared on the surface
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If it was consistently you, ask: was your partner ever confronted about this imbalance, and what was their response?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If effort was genuinely mutual, explore what specific stressor triggered the breakdown

diagnostic_questions.question: Did you feel a sense of relief when the relationship ended, even alongside grief?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Relief co-occurring with grief is a strong signal that part of you already knew the relationship had run its course — it distinguishes a situational loss from the ending of something that was still genuinely working
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What specifically were you relieved about? That question surfaces the actual problem the relationship had been generating
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Was the ending entirely a surprise? If so, probe for whether emotional withdrawal signals were present but unread

diagnostic_questions.question: Did your ex's withdrawal begin around the same time a specific other person entered their social circle?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the stated reason for the breakup (e.g., 'your jealousy') was the actual cause or a socially acceptable framing of a different underlying cause (e.g., developing feelings for someone else)
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Is the self-improvement you are doing addressing the actual cause, or the stated cause? Would you be comfortable with the possibility that they are returning because the other option didn't work out?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Is the behavior pattern they cited something you have sought professional help for, or are you assuming you have fixed it through willpower alone?

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the avoidant ex ever actually changed their behavior after a previous return, or only their stated intentions?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the pattern is a repeating cycle or a genuine repair attempt — behavioral change in conflict style is the diagnostic signal, not declarations
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How long did the behavioral change last, and under what conditions did it break down?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: This is a repeating pattern, not a repairable rough patch — the second ending is likely to mirror the first

diagnostic_questions.question: Did they pull away specifically when the relationship became stable, comfortable, and drama-free — rather than in response to a specific conflict or problem?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the departure is likely driven by avoidant attachment (a structural trait) versus a specific, addressable issue in the relationship
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: The pattern is likely to repeat if they return — the relationship becoming safe will trigger the same withdrawal; ask whether you want to try to repair something that will destabilize again at the same point
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: The departure may be tied to a specific, potentially addressable issue — identify what the triggering conflict or change was and whether it is something both parties can work on

diagnostic_questions.question: What is this person doing right now, compared to what they said was the reason they left?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the stated breakup reason was genuine or a socially acceptable cover for wanting to exit without accountability
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If behavior contradicts the stated reason (e.g., back on dating apps after citing religious conviction), the stated reason was likely false — redirect grief toward the deception, not the stated incompatibility
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If behavior is consistent with the stated reason (e.g., actually pursuing religious practice, actually going to therapy), the stated reason may be worth taking at face value even if painful

diagnostic_questions.question: In your last three significant conflicts, who initiated the repair conversation?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the relationship has a structural asymmetry in emotional labor and conflict engagement
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If it was always you: has your partner ever initiated repair unprompted? If not, this is a pattern, not a phase.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If it was shared: what happened when the other person initiated — did you engage or withdraw?

diagnostic_questions.question: Beyond enjoying each other's company, are you and your partner actually aligned on morals, financial goals, family goals, parenting approaches, emotional intelligence, and communication styles?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the relationship has structural compatibility or is primarily sustained by attraction and connection — the latter predicts failure after the honeymoon phase
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How explicitly have these been discussed and tested under stress, not just assumed?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Is either person willing and able to genuinely shift on these dimensions, or are you hoping to 'work it out later'?

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the rejecting person's hostility predate any action by the child, going back to the child's earliest years or even birth?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Hostility that predates any possible offense by the child strongly suggests the child is a symbol of trauma (assault, forced pregnancy, loss of autonomy) rather than a genuine interpersonal antagonist
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Is there evidence of a religious or controlling family environment, a significant age gap, or circumstances around the birth that were never fully explained?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Was there a specific triggering event or life transition that changed the relationship — this may be a more repairable interpersonal conflict

diagnostic_questions.question: Who sent the hostile message — the friend or her partner?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: If the partner sent the message, the friend may not be in control of the communication at all. The rupture may be the partner's decision, not the friend's.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Is there any history of the partner controlling or speaking disparagingly to/about the friend? If so, treat this as a potential coercive control situation, not a friendship conflict.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If the friend herself sent the hostile message, the friendship rupture is more likely genuine and can be addressed directly through apology and remediation.

diagnostic_questions.question: Is your partner's anger directed at the fact that you found out, or at the underlying accusation of infidelity?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Anger at being caught (without denying the act) is a behavioral admission. Anger at the accusation typically includes denial and explanation. The absence of any denial here is significant.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If anger is at discovery only — has he made any attempt to deny or explain the content of what was found?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If he is engaging with the accusation — is he providing verifiable explanations for the specific corroborated claims?

diagnostic_questions.question: Has your family member's interference been a single incident or a pattern with multiple timestamps?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Distinguishes a boundary violation that can be addressed with a single direct conversation from a sustained campaign requiring structural consequences like reduced contact
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How long has this been occurring, and has it escalated? What triggered the start?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Was this incident severe enough on its own to warrant immediate boundary-setting, even if isolated?

diagnostic_questions.question: Is there physical evidence of the tampering, or is the suspicion based solely on an unexpected pregnancy?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Physical evidence (pills found in trash, packaging discrepancies) moves the situation from suspicion to documented fact, changing both the legal options and the appropriate response urgency.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Document and preserve the physical evidence immediately; consult a lawyer or law enforcement about reporting options before confronting the partner.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Seek a third-party admission via text before making accusations; consider whether other explanations for the pregnancy failure have been ruled out.

diagnostic_questions.question: Has your partner ever gotten angry at you, not just distant or unhelpful, but actively frustrated or blaming, when you were sick, injured, or physically compromised?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the partner's response is passive (checked out) or active (punishing you for needing care) — active blame responses are a higher-severity signal
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Has this happened more than once, across different types of vulnerability (illness, postpartum, exhaustion)? If yes, it is a stable pattern not a single bad response
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Does your partner become distant or absent during your vulnerability without blaming you? If yes, explore whether basic care is present even if conflict isn't

diagnostic_questions.question: What did the partner expect to happen as a result of calling the police?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Forces evaluation of whether any good-faith outcome was plausible. If no good-faith outcome exists (e.g., police finding fiction harmful to the author), the action cannot be explained by genuine concern
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If a good-faith outcome was plausible, was it the most likely outcome the partner was anticipating, or does the actual sequence suggest a different intended outcome?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If no good-faith outcome was plausible, what does that tell you about the actual intent behind the action?

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the partner been constructing a parallel narrative to the outside world — telling family, friends, or a dating-app audience that the relationship is already over?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the infidelity is a discrete betrayal within an otherwise committed relationship, or evidence that the partner has already emotionally and practically exited and is managing optics
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: The relationship is not repairable in any meaningful sense — the partner has already made a unilateral exit decision. The question shifts to logistics of separation.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Ask whether this is a pattern of behavior or an isolated incident — the answer determines whether couples work or clean separation is the correct path

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the person who breached your confidence still have social proximity to the third party they disclosed to?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the breach was a one-time accident or a structural ongoing leak — if the social connection remains, the risk of future disclosure is high regardless of apology
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Assume future disclosures will happen; decide whether to report based on professional harm, not on whether you believe the apology
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: The immediate structural risk is lower, but the professional violation still occurred and may still warrant reporting on its own merits

diagnostic_questions.question: How does your partner talk about people they are not attracted to or invested in — strangers, unattractive people, people 'below' them socially?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether their positive treatment of you reflects genuine character or is a performance conditional on your fitting their standards
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If they speak respectfully about everyone regardless of attractiveness, the incident may be more isolated; still warrants examination of what caused the unguarded moment
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If they routinely speak dismissively or cruelly about people they don't find attractive, this incident is a pattern, not an aberration — the relationship's foundation is conditional respect

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the friend's anger their own, or is it being sustained or manufactured by their partner?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the repair work needs to happen with the friend directly, or whether the real obstacle is the partner's ongoing influence — a fundamentally different and harder problem.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Is the partner's influence pervasive enough that repair will repeatedly be undone? Does the friend have enough autonomy to sustain the repaired friendship?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: What does the friend actually feel, and is a direct conversation — away from the partner — sufficient to restore the relationship?

diagnostic_questions.question: Did your partner's stated change of values occur before or after learning of the triggering event (pregnancy, diagnosis, job loss, etc.)?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the value change is a genuine evolution or a reactive position adopted in response to a fait accompli
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Ask them to describe when and why the shift happened — a coherent, specific account suggests genuine change
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Treat the incompatibility as real and current, not as temporary overwhelm

diagnostic_questions.question: When you told your partner about a health crisis or emergency, did they express concern for your wellbeing — or did they respond with anger, dismissal, or self-referential statements?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: A partner's response to your vulnerability is one of the clearest diagnostic signals for whether empathy exists in the relationship; anger or self-focus in response to your medical emergency indicates an absence of basic care
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Is this concern consistent, or does it appear selectively when the partner wants something?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Has this pattern of dismissing your physical or emotional needs appeared before? How many times?

diagnostic_questions.question: Does your partner's family believe you two have been broken up for months while you were still actively in the relationship?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: The cheating partner has been maintaining a completely separate narrative with their family — the primary relationship was already treated as over in the cheater's social world without the primary partner's knowledge
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Ask when your partner's family last believed you were together — this likely marks when the deception became systematic, not impulsive
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Assess whether the family was simply kept uninformed versus actively misled — uninformed is a different warning signal than actively deceived

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the radicalized partner's behavior created any documented or documentable incidents — police contact, medical treatment, school/childcare reports?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether there is an existing evidentiary record that strengthens a custody case beyond testimony alone
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Have you preserved all records? Have you consulted a family lawyer about how to introduce them?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Are you actively logging incidents with dates, descriptions, and any witnesses? A contemporaneous diary is admissible in many jurisdictions.

diagnostic_questions.question: Has this exact failure — not gifting on a major holiday — happened before with this partner?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether this is an isolated oversight or an established behavioral pattern
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How was it addressed after the first occurrence, and did the partner acknowledge the expectation at that time?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Were there other signals of asymmetric investment or effort in non-gift domains?

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the grieving partner actively rejecting therapeutic input, or simply progressing slowly through it?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Slow progress is expected and normal in grief therapy; active cynical rejection of all therapeutic input indicates a defense mechanism that blocks recovery regardless of time invested
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Is this rejection paired with a belief that the partner 'knows better' than the therapist? If so, is there any external authority or framework the partner does respect?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: What specific areas has therapy produced even marginal movement in? Use those as anchors to assess whether forward motion is occurring

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the locked space in the shared home exclusively controlled by one partner, with the other needing to ask for access?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether a structural power imbalance over shared domestic space has been established — a locked room with a missing key is not toddler-proofing, it is spousal exclusion
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How long has this arrangement existed, and was it installed unilaterally or by mutual agreement?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Is there a different space, device, or account that operates similarly — accessible to one partner but not the other?

diagnostic_questions.question: Is this forgetfulness an isolated incident or a documented recurring pattern in the relationship?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether this requires an apology and a fix, or a structural conversation about how executive function differences are being managed in the relationship
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Has the partner previously expressed frustration or absorbed compensatory labor because of this pattern? If so, the gift incident is the presenting symptom of a larger dynamic that needs naming.
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: A one-time incident with immediate honest disclosure is very likely to be forgiven, especially given the partner's demonstrated warmth

diagnostic_questions.question: Do friends volunteer concern about your partner without being asked, and have they done so across multiple separate occasions?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Volunteered, repeated concern from independent observers indicates the behavior is overt and consistent enough to register without prompting — this is much stronger signal than concern expressed only when asked
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Ask each person for specific incidents and note whether incidents cluster around the same behavioral categories (dismissal, interruption, negative commentary about others)
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Ask whether friends have ever felt hesitant to say something, or whether they have declined invitations without explanation

diagnostic_questions.question: Did the partner come out as polyamorous before or after a specific outside person appeared?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Sequencing distinguishes genuine identity disclosure from retroactive justification of an existing or planned outside relationship
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How quickly after the disclosure did the specific person appear? Were there earlier signs of interest in this person?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Is the partner showing equal enthusiasm for the other partner pursuing connections? Is freedom genuinely mutual?

diagnostic_questions.question: When your partner is absent, do you struggle with tasks you handled easily before this relationship?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether functional dependency has developed — the gap between pre-relationship capability and current performance under solo conditions
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How long has this gap been present, and did you notice it building gradually or only when forced to act alone?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: The dynamic may be supportive rather than dependency-creating — the division of labor may not be eroding independent capability

diagnostic_questions.question: Has this partner ever shown up for you in a high-stakes moment, or is the absence of support consistent across all moments of real need?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the current behavior is a deviation from a baseline of care (rough patch) or the baseline itself (character/relationship quality)
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: What was the last time they showed up? How long ago was it? Has something changed since then that might explain the current behavior?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If there is no counterfactual instance of genuine support, the relationship lacks the foundational repair material — absence of positive evidence is itself data.

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the partner ever sought, accepted, or sustained professional treatment for the condition driving the conflict?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the problem is a condition being managed with external support or a behavioral pattern the partner is choosing not to address
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Is the treatment ongoing and producing measurable improvement in the conflict frequency or severity?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Has treatment been suggested and refused, or has it simply never been discussed? Refusal after suggestion is a materially different signal than ignorance of options.

diagnostic_questions.question: Did your partner disclose the emotional affair before or after it became physical, and how long had the outside contact been ongoing before disclosure?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the disclosure represents a genuine attempt to repair trust before full betrayal, or a managed exit strategy after months of concealment — these have very different implications for whether repair is viable
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If disclosed before physical infidelity: Was the disclosure voluntary or prompted by discovery? Voluntary disclosure may indicate some residual commitment to honesty
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If contact had been ongoing for months with no disclosure: The sustained concealment during active future-planning (house purchase) is a stronger predictor of exit intent than a momentary lapse

diagnostic_questions.question: Before the affair was discovered, were there incidents where your partner manufactured your distress or treated your emotional reactions as something to be tested or managed rather than responded to with care?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the affair exists within a broader pattern of contempt and control, or whether it was an isolated betrayal in an otherwise functional relationship — this distinction is critical for assessing repairability
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: How many such incidents can you identify? Were they escalating or isolated? Did you raise them at the time and how did your partner respond? — these answers indicate whether the pattern is stable and therefore whether repair is realistic
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Was this a relationship with genuine mutual respect outside of the affair? If yes, the conditions for repair work may exist — explore whether the affair was a symptom of unaddressed relationship problems both partners contributed to

diagnostic_questions.question: When you raise a specific hurt or grievance, does your partner first acknowledge that you feel hurt — even briefly — before explaining their own perspective?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the partner has a basic capacity for empathy and repair; partners who skip acknowledgment entirely and go straight to self-defense or counter-attack are showing you the ceiling of the relationship's repairability
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Does the acknowledgment lead to any behavioral change, or is it verbal only and followed by the same pattern?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Has this happened consistently across multiple conversations, or was this an isolated high-stress moment? If consistent, treat it as a stable trait, not a bad day.

diagnostic_questions.question: Did your partner ever take unexplained actions that seemed to correspond with things you only discussed digitally or privately?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the partner has been monitoring communications — a key safety factor for exit planning
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Assume all current devices and accounts are compromised; plan exit communications on a new device or account the partner has never had access to
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Still audit device access as a precaution, but communication monitoring is less likely to have been the trigger for unexpected partner behavior

diagnostic_questions.question: When you told your partner they were free to leave, did they take that exit — or did they backtrack and reframe their earlier statement?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Backtracking when given an easy exit indicates the original ultimatum was a control mechanism, not a genuine statement of preference or limit
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: The partner's behavior is consistent — evaluate whether that limit is acceptable to you
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Ask why the partner issued the threat if they did not mean it, and whether they acknowledged and apologized for the impact

diagnostic_questions.question: When you explained how their behavior made you feel, did they engage with your experience or redirect to explaining/defending themselves?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the partner has the capacity for genuine accountability or defaults to self-protection when confronted
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Did they also offer an explanation for where the behavior came from, without using it as an excuse to avoid change?
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Is this a consistent pattern when conflict arises — do they rarely acknowledge impact on you?

diagnostic_questions.question: Who were you emotionally and psychologically before this relationship, and who are you now?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the relationship is producing personal growth or personal deterioration — a concrete, self-observable metric that bypasses rationalization
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: If you have become more anxious, irritable, or pessimistic: ask whether any specific change in the relationship or your behavior has caused this, or whether it is a stable pattern
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If you have stayed the same or improved: examine whether exhaustion or confusion about the relationship's purpose is still present, as that is a separate warning signal
